purpose: Bounded current-main discrimination of PressureFlow quiet-water cost at the #370 host scale, with reference/cached/cached_dormant same-law parity and FreeMass as cost context only. Not a speedup threshold, not a default decision.

diagnostic_before_registration.case: pool-vented workers 1 replicate 0 alone; the four other scale profiles at workers 4 replicate 1 run concurrently as a fixture smoke
diagnostic_before_registration.status: mechanism discovery and fixture smoke only (all five completed with full parity); excluded from every registered summary; concurrent timings are contaminated

scale_apparatus.reuses: native/bench/lcb_pressure_optimization.cpp translation unit unchanged (equivalence, counters, memory snapshot, head comparison, peak RSS)
scale_apparatus.geometry: lcb.rest.deep-quiet-pool.v1 (#370 quiet pool) prepared through PreparedWorldBuilder at the controlled host configuration: chunk 128, maximum chunks 128, active cores 1024, active chunks 128, parallel threshold 2, rule radius 2, Water policy 8/12, configured Baseline transport, diagnostics enabled, obstacle field 0,0,1024,1024, interest 16,16,992,272

profiles.state: quiet pool under a one-cell lid, 7,552-cell sealed headspace; no edits
sealed pool; tail toggles a headspace Wall pixel every 8 ticks and vents/reseals the lid every 32 ticks
vented pool; tail moves an 8x8 native body mask across the half-submerged surface every 4 ticks
vented pool; tail toggles a lid cell over one surface column every tick

scale_apparatus.arm_order: World preparation and every tick rotate (replicate + tick + position) mod 4

platform_check.host: WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 on the same physical machine; never pooled with Windows timings

attribution.tool: perf record -g (WSL2), pool-vented workers 1 replicate 0 under a separate -O2 -g build
attribution.status: symbol attribution only; profiled timings are never used as benchmark values

failure_policy: Any nonzero exit, stderr byte, timeout, parity refusal or source/executable fence change stops that cohort. Raw output is retained; nothing is retried, relaxed or dropped.
reported_statistics: per child: tick milliseconds p50/p95/p99/max per arm and phase, mean per-tick counters, preparation/gas/head nanoseconds, visits, motion calls, jobs and claimants; across replicates: medians of per-child values and per-replicate candidate/reference ratios. Windows and Linux are reported separately.
host_controls: local desktop; uncontrolled background scheduling; process-name/CPU inventories before and after each cohort
